description: This file contains the implementation of a test-specific queue balancer class 'LeaseBasedQueueBalancerForTest' used for managing stream queue leases in a testing context. It interacts with a lease manager grain to acquire and manage queue responsibilities.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancerForTest
classes.description: A test implementation of a stream queue balancer that acquires leases once and does not renew, primarily used for testing stream queue distribution.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the queue balancer with a given name and grain factory.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the queue leases using the provided queue mapper.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Placeholder for shutdown operations; currently does nothing.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues owned by this balancer.

methods.name: GetInitialLease
methods.description: Acquires initial lease responsibilities from the lease manager grain.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to queue distribution change events (no-op).

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from queue distribution change events (no-op).
